name: / BARBARA STROZZI /
description:
Barbara Strozzi written in JavaScript, with logarithms, which will definitely turn it into a unique and animated work of art, by reading the color data of each pixel and altering its course based on a set of configurable rules.
Barbara Strozzi (1619 -1677) was an Italian composer and singer of the Baroque Period. During her lifetime, Strozzi published eight volumes of her own music, and had more secular music in print than any other composer of the era.This was achieved without any support from the Church and with no consistent patronage from the nobility.

name: Chronicles 2020 - The Halving
description:
2020 is the year I got involved with crypto and NFTs so creating my Chronicles piece for this year was very special to me. I chose to focus on the Bitcoin Halving and incorporate elements from the year into this audio/visual artwork.

Not Fungible’s inaugural series is called Chronicles which tells the story of cryptocurrency through exquisitely crafted NFT’s. The collection recounts the most iconic moments in blockchain history, year through year. name: Woman taking selfie on a cliff | Claude Monet x Van Glitch

description:
Over the past four months I have focused my artistic activity on collaborating with some of my favorite artists. The first artist I had the privilege of collaborating with is Claude Monet: we spent almost a month and a half together, and we made several works that I finally have the pleasure of presenting to you.

The first of the works created with Monet is "Woman taking selfie on a cliff", made between 18 and 21 April 2022. To find the right location, Monet and I went to the Cliffs of Etretat area, near the Chambre des Damoiselles, a crevasse nestled at the top of the Aval cliff.

name: Golden Power (+49)
description: Art has among its expression options that of being able to transmit a critical vision of reality. Golden Power (+49) is a work from the Golden Power series that literally shows the relationship between power and economy. The symbols of our political reality are transformed into idols of social reality. Meanings thus acquire new interpretations, perhaps more real than before.

name: Mime Frozen in Time
description:
The shot was taken on and around the historical streets of Prague, July 2004 on a bright beautiful summer day. Among others from that week, these handful of pantomime shots were the only ones I took over 30 years of photography.

It took forever to edit this and the companions. Literally tens of edits over 10+ years. Perhaps blockchain will be the answer the mime's constant evolution will pass on to the stewardship of someone who cares and  nurtures it in their own way.

I hope to mint couple of more from the series on MakersPlace.

Mime Frozen in Time
Artwork by Hulki Okan Tabak

name: SteamPunk Me
description:
"SteamPunk: Colonizing the Past so we can dream the future"
In this fantasy I am combining Victorian-era optimism with Digital-era creativity.

I love the idea of intentionally calling upon the Past for the inspiration to build a better Future. Making a place where each individual is empowered to explore personal creativity.

description: I wanted to create something that was colorful and fun.  Originally painted with oils on canvas. This art is AR ( Augmented Reality ) Ready AR. Watch the Hair move , color change, and Eyes open and close, with some additional animation. You can test it here on screen with the free Artivive app. The technology is built with Artivive, a free app that you can download from the apple store or Google Play.

name: Organs of Emotion: Trust
description:
This artwork is derived from a high-quality scan of my original drawing, "Organ", which I created using calligraphy ink on a rough-textured handmade mulberry paper. Using color, I have injected additional emotion into this already organic form.

Each artwork is colorized, one-by-one, based on Plutchik’s Wheel of Emotion. There are 8 groups of emotions in this series.
